inlines.v: AUS'TRIAN, adjective [from Austria. This word is formed with the Latin termination, ia, country.] Pertaining to Austria, a circle or district of Germany, and an empire, lying on the Danube north of the gulf of Venice. AUS'TRIAN, noun A native of Austria.
